KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.title: Tournament Cafeteria
KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.pages.INITI: The World Martial Arts Tournament cafeteria smells incredible. A vendor eyes the growing stack of empty bowls at your table: "Just a snack this time, or are you gonna clean us out again?"
Grab the free side dish. Heal 6 HP.
Spend 40 gold on mains and stew. Heal 12 HP.
You can't afford the full meal right now.
KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.pages.LIGHT: You only eat twelve bowls, which counts as a snack for a Saiyan. You heal 6 HP. Time for the next match!
KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.pages.FEAST: Soup, roast, rice, then more rice. The kitchen staff watch in horror. You pay 40 gold and heal 12 HP, completely refueled.
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.title: Mystical Adventure
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.pages.INITI: An old storybook flips open on its own. Two chapters glow: a boy with a tail meeting a girl hunting Dragon Balls, and the last page, where the journey ends. Which story do you read?
A boy and a girl meet, and the greatest adventure begins. Upgrade 2 random cards in your deck.
Two heroes say goodbye, and a perfect story finds its ending. Lose 10 Max HP, then choose 2 cards in your deck to remove.
You need at least 2 removable cards in your deck to accept this ending.
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.pages.BEGIN: Soft light washes over your deck. Two cards grow stronger as the story unfolds. The adventure is just getting started.
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.pages.GOODB: You pay the price: 10 Max HP lost, two cards gone forever. The story ends with a wave goodbye, but somehow it never really feels over.
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.title: The Emperor Arrives
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.pages.INITIA: Violet light tears open the sky above Namek. Frieza's army descends, and the emperor of the universe smiles down at Goku. "Don't get too excited. This isn't even my final form."
Fully heal the team and face Frieza.
Skip the optional boss and continue to the normal ending.
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.pages.DECLIN: You leave the emperor's challenge unanswered. Somewhere above, Frieza scoffs. The journey through the Spire proceeds to its original conclusion.
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.pages.VICTOR: Black Frieza collapses beneath the final blow. His presence fades, and for once he has no forms left. The true victory is finally yours.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_KORIN_TOWER_TRIAL.pag: Wind sweeps the top of the tower. Korin swirls the Sacred Water and nods at a jar of Senzu Beans. "Want the water? Take it from me. Nobody's pulled that off in a long time."
Lose 8 Max HP. Obtain the Sacred Water Jug.
You chase Korin around the tower until your legs give out, then lunge one last time. Somehow, the Sacred Water Jug ends up in your hands.
Korin tosses you the jar. One bean keeps a fighter going for ten days. Make them count.
You leave the trial for another day. Korin strokes his whiskers and goes back to his nap.
